next_demonstrated_producer_gap.title: Ordinary TFM family and optical-size identity is not preserved in math outline resource selection
next_demonstrated_producer_gap.observed_behavior: Producer mathtex::otf_gid uses base(ch) for ordinary non-extension TFM families. Reference employs MathItalic8/12, Roman8/12, MathSymbols10/Extension10, while original binds one LatinModernMath face. This is a demonstrated resource-selection difference, not proof that every differing pixel has that cause.
